Suggested timing: 2:00–3:00

DEMO SCRIPT
1. Open Simulator. Select Multilayer assembly. Confirm T₀ = 80 °C, Tenv = 0 °C and 15 minutes.
2. Run the model and point to T(15) = 63.9 °C.
3. Open Measurements. Load or show the supplied full-MLI series. Point to 16/16 points and MAE = 0.98 °C.
4. Explain that residuals change sign because the measured curve does not follow one perfect exponential.

Fallback: remain on this slide if Chart.js, KaTeX or web fonts do not load. The screenshots preserve the exact demonstration state.
